assumptions: The pipeline is named sas_restructure (from the request), not sas_folder_restructure (the document's name).

Path patterns such as /adam/, /data_reuse/ and raw/ are checked against the folder path relative to incoming/ with a '/' added at its start and end, so a pattern also matches the first or last folder.
All substring checks are case-sensitive except the 'ar' folder name and reporting level in CDAR (compared in lowercase); the ANON 'ia' check is case-sensitive as stated.
The CDAR reporting level is written in the target as found in the path (original case) after the ia_ normalisation; only the comparison is done in lowercase.
Underscore formats use the same precedence as slash formats: _adam_, then _sdtm_, then _raw_/_restricted_raw_.
In CDAP and ANON interim paths, 'ia_ + the rest' means the part with its leading 'ia' removed, prefixed with 'ia_' (ia300 -> ia_300).
A rule whose condition holds but whose target cannot be worked out (e.g. CDAR with no 'ar' folder) still counts as a match; the file goes to error/.
Error targets keep the full path relative to incoming/, including the file name.
The cron expression is kept as written; '*/45' in the minute field fires at minutes 0 and 45 of each hour, not strictly every 45 minutes.
Report lines are written to the run log; no separate report file is stated.
Moved files and error/ files are outside incoming/, so they are never picked up again.
Synthetic study IDs (99-0001, S-001) and file names replace the document's sample identifiers in the examples.

questions.text: Are path patterns (/adam/, /data_reuse/, /med, raw/ ...) case-sensitive, apart from the 'ar' folder and ANON 'ia' rules?
Should patterns such as /adam/ also match when adam is the first or last folder of the folder path?
questions.proposed_assumption: Yes; the folder path is checked with '/' added at both ends.

questions.text: Is the CDAR reporting level written in the target in lowercase, or as found in the path?
questions.proposed_assumption: As found in the path; only the comparison is lowercase.

questions.text: In CDAP interim, if the third '_' part does not start with 'ia', what is written?
questions.proposed_assumption: ia_ + the whole third part (leading 'ia' is removed only when present).

questions.text: Cron '*/45 * * * *' fires at minutes 0 and 45 of every hour, not strictly every 45 minutes. Is that intended?
questions.proposed_assumption: Keep the cron expression as written.

questions.text: Where should the per-file report lines go (run log, a report object in S3)?
If a delete fails after a successful copy, the source stays and the next run copies it again (overwriting). Is that acceptable?
questions.proposed_assumption: Yes; the overwrite rule makes the retry safe.
